title: CPF Module Schema: Microsoft Fabric module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-fabriccapacity'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

administration_members.description: (Required) A list of member object IDs or email addresses that will be administrators for the Fabric capacity

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

resource_group_id.description: (Required) The ID of the azure resource group in which this resource is created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

sku.description: (Required) The SKU settings for the Microsoft Fabric. The object contains the following properties: name = "(Required) The name of the SKU. Possible values are F2, F4, F8, F16, F32, F64, F128, F256, F512, F1024, F2048." tier = "(Optional) The tier of the SKU."

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Fabric Capacity.

name.description: The Name of the Fabric Capacity.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Fabriccapacity' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
